extensionShortName.description: Short name shown when space is limited

extensionDescription.message: Automatically capture webpages on a schedule. Visible-area or full-page scrolling screenshots, saved locally. No tracking, no uploads.

captureFailed.message:
Screenshot failed: $ERROR$

Open the extension page for details (chrome://extensions → Details → Inspect views).

optionsIntro.message: Configure every Auto Screenshot Saver option. Select Save when you are finished.

fullPageHint.message: Full-page mode scrolls and stitches the page into one image—ideal for long articles and chat logs.

overlapHint.message: Overlap between adjacent segments (0–500). A value from 50–200 can reduce repeated fixed elements.

maxHeightHint.message: Pages taller than this are captured from the top to avoid excessive memory use. Recommended: 10000–30000.

downloadSubfolderHint.message: Chrome only allows subfolders inside your default Downloads directory.

confirmReset.message: Restore every option to its default value?

pageSizeUnavailable.message: Could not determine the page size

offscreenCanvasUnavailable.message: This Chrome version does not support OffscreenCanvas, so it cannot stitch a full-page image

canvasLimitExceeded.message: The stitched size ($SIZE$) exceeds Chrome's canvas limit. Reduce Maximum height in Advanced settings or narrow the browser window.

imageConversionFailed.message: Image conversion failed. The image may be too large or the format may be unsupported.
